items.title: Calligraphic Basmala Inscription Ornate Frame CNC Art
items.description: Deliver a profound spiritual and visual centerpiece with this masterfully designed ornate frame featuring a detailed calligraphic inscription of the Basmala (Bismillahi-Rahmani-Rahim). Encased in a complex geometric lattice border, this production-ready vector art is delivered in clean DXF, SVG, and DWG formats for flawless high-precision execution on fiber laser and CNC machines. Highly recommended for workshop owners fabricating bespoke architectural art, feature screens for Islamic centers, and high-end residential wall decor.
